name: Crate Remote
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Browse both USBs on an iPad, see what fits, and send a pick to the deck: highlighted, or loaded on a stopped deck.
description: Browse both USBs on an iPad or phone and send a pick to the deck. Open http://crate-remote.local:8765 (or the Wi-Fi or cable address on this mod's page) on the deck's Wi-Fi or a cable to the LINK port, and enter the PIN shown there. Show on deck puts the browser on the track; Load presses LOAD only for a stopped deck and checks the deck got it. It drives the deck's own controls (PLAYLIST, knob, clicks); touching any control stops it. Uses the network (port 8765) and runs avahi-publish for the .local name. Never writes the library.
